description.value: Brown's Socialhouse Semiahmoo is a casual full-service chain restaurant situated at the corner of the Semiahmoo Shopping Centre in South Surrey, described as within walking distance of the beach. The restaurant offers both indoor seating and an outdoor patio, making it a relaxed stop in a seaside community. It is one of dozens of Browns Socialhouse locations across BC and Alberta, operated under the Browns Restaurant Group.
